author: Cleo Abram
description:
Once you die how long does it actually take for your body to break down until there’s nothing left but bones? It’s a morbid thought but scientists study this pretty extensively and the process is WILD. The answer depends entirely on how fast you're eaten… both from the outside AND from the inside. To find out, subscribe!

#skeleton #biology #halloween #science
title: You’re Dead. What Next?
